candidates.name: Doanh Tran
candidates.reason: The submitted profileUrl (https://www.fda.gov/media/194885/download) is a downloadable PDF document (September 2026 public workshop agenda and speaker bios), which is explicitly unacceptable under Test 1 ('Not acceptable as profileUrl: a homepage/landing page, a news story, a publication or PDF, ORCID, Scholar, ResearchGate, LinkedIn, a team-wide page that does not single out the person, or a former employer'). The FDA does not publish individual HTML staff profile pages for CDER review division leadership, and no personal website or portfolio stating his current appointment exists. Although Dr. Tran holds a PhD, serves as Deputy Director of the Division of Cardiometabolic and Endocrine Pharmacology with qualifying peer-reviewed clinical pharmacology publications (satisfying test 2), possesses an affirmative Vietnamese given name ('Doanh', test 3), passed dedup screening (test 4), and is US-based (test 5), he cannot be admitted to the roster without an acceptable profileUrl that meets Test 1.
